features.name: Bounded anonymous own methods and properties
features.scope: Stored val/var properties, computed properties with explicit or inherited types, custom getters/setters and backing fields, private accessors, additional explicit-result methods, own and enclosing receivers, declaration-order initialization and fresh per-instance state. Public providers and fixed Java callers, all four existing Kotlin provider/consumer pairs, and superclass initialization are exercised.
restrictions: One or more supported class/interface supertypes remain required. Anonymous Kotlin metadata and EnclosingMethod/reflection parity are not claimed.

Delegates, property annotations, accessor visibility, Unit properties, own method and computed-property result inference remain outside this subset. Publicly exposed own-member results require explicit supported result types.
Initializer own receivers and references to not-yet-declared own properties are explicitly unsupported. Inferred own property types depend on supported enclosing or inherited type information.

features.name: Explicit constructors for supported functional interfaces
features.scope: Literal-lambda constructors for same-package, imported and qualified compiled Kotlin fun interfaces and Java functional interfaces, explicit generic arguments, source fun interfaces, default dispatch and captured mutable cells.
restrictions: Function-valued and callable-reference adapters, implicit constructor lambda labels and generic argument inference remain outside this tested constructor subset.
Only public nonsynthetic callable descriptors and generic signatures are ABI parity claims; generated accessor layouts are excluded.

features.name: Explicit imported classifier and same-FQN factory resolution
features.scope: An imported Kotlin classifier name and import aliases retain ordinary same-FQN package factory overloads. Inferred/explicit generic interface factory calls and nongeneric Kotlin constructor/factory overload selection use normal library invocation. Ambiguous and inapplicable calls reject.
restrictions: Concrete generic classifier constructor/factory competition is outside the bounded subset.
This evidence covers explicit imports. It does not claim arbitrary source-local, wildcard or synthetic-SAM factory competition.

features.name: Unchanged HighlightTracker production source
features.scope: The pinned AndroidBible HighlightTracker.kt compiles unchanged. The same 23 original official JUnit tests pass against original and replacement providers with JVM verification.
restrictions: Original Gradle-built test and dependency class files are reused. No Android runtime, full application or performance claim.
DownloadMapper advances past CoroutineScope factory resolution and remains rejected at its synchronized call.

corrections.reason: Development ABI extraction included compiler-generated synthetic accessors. The final SAM report compares public nonsynthetic callables and states the narrower ABI contract.
Development run was interrupted before final validation to rebuild immutable-property diagnostics; the completed anonymous-objects report supersedes it.
